models.title: Self-gravitating galaxy and its fixed-field controls
models.evolves: Stellar and halo particles; live components alter gravity. Named frozen/static controls remove specified response.
models.supports: Behavior and numerical sensitivity of the specified galaxy models
models.excludes: No SIDM comparison; no converged universal bar-strength prediction

models.title: Prescribed-field Cartesian orbits
models.evolves: Test particles in an external analytical field, imposed bar and disturbances; cloud does not react collectively
models.supports: Particle response to those specified external fields

models.title: Reduced noisy resonance, positive population
models.evolves: Slow action and resonant angle; constant additive action diffusion; fixed fast-action slice
models.clock: Dimensionless T, x and impulse B
models.supports: Population response and numerical accuracy within this local operator
models.excludes: Not full-halo torque, SIDM or general confidence coverage

models.title: Earlier signed perturbation with reservoirs
models.evolves: Signed deviation with its own reservoir/boundary conditions
models.supports: Verification and response of that separate setup

models.title: Synthetic controls
models.evolves: Known stochastic laws or analytical limiting processes
models.supports: Verification of estimators, coordinates or numerical algorithms
